name: Hot soy milk
summary: Sweet hot soy milk for a cool Da Lat evening, carried in a cup from the market.
origin: An evening drink at the Da Lat market and the night market. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names it for the cool air.
howToEat: Take a cup after dark, when the air cools, and walk with it.
The stall price is Check on arrival.
where: Da Lat Market and the night market in the centre. Visit Lâm Đồng puts the night stalls at about 18:00–23:00.
seoTitle: Hot soy milk — Da Lat night market
seoDescription: Sữa đậu nành nóng at the Da Lat market after dark. The stall price is Check on arrival.
